kinds.L: Liquid or instant-unstake. Lock inner token/receipt, instant redeem same thing. HyperEVM ticker hPREFIX.
kinds.C1: Long lock / no transferable receipt. Inbound only. Exit is the HyperEVM market. Ticker encodes lock.
kinds.C2: Unstake exists with a known wait. Burn hToken, wait redeemDelay, claim inner on source.

testnet.note: Go-live is mainnet (docs/GROK_BOT_MAINNET.md). HyperEVM testnet DVNs are only LayerZero Labs + P2P. Do not treat 998 as wrap acceptance.

listings.name: Hyperleaf sKAITO
listings.claim: owner setClaimCall(campaign, selector); anyone pokeClaim; then pullYield
listings.note: L redeem returns sKAITO, not KAITO (official unstake is 7d cooldown — protocol never calls it). sKAITO is transferable; Base spot is thin. On HyperEVM hKAITO is also the KAITO spot proxy. BLACKLISTED_ROLE exists; team describes it as investor airdrop exclusion — if the lockbox is ever listed, L redeem can fail. Eco airdrops are per-campaign Sign contracts, often linear vest.

listings.note: L returns xSQUID. Principal redeem is 1:1 QUID at Squid. Extra QUID is claimRewards, not share-price. Never pull xSQUID.

Only ETH PoS, in exchangeRate(). retainRateYield: harvest pulls 1% of (inner * dRate / rate) to converter as protocol fee; 99% stays so LP/lend keep the ETH value. Holders do not claim WHYPE. listings.name: Hyperleaf VIRTUAL MAX

ETH/Arb/Robinhood (4663) claims need the omnichain holder; RH gas makes dust negative EV. Same holder blocker as hKAITO.

listings.name: Hyperleaf River Pts max-date
listings.note: BSC. Live convert: 100,000 River Pts → 394.77 RIVER into sRIVER_V2 ERC-721 #22014, unlock 2028-10-01 14:00 UTC. convert(pts, 1, 7, minOut) 0x03063b98. Weekly extra Pts is a merkle claim on 0x6965… claim(uint256,uint256,bytes32[]) 0xae0b51df — sample 0x000b0c14 paid 20,805 Pts to the EOA. Compound path: lockbox (must be the merkle leaf) claims Pts, then convert epoch 7 so new RIVER sits in another/same sRIVER_V2 NFT. Keeper supplies the proof each week (River UI / tree). If River snapshots the original wallet instead of the NFT owner, this yield is stripped — same class as KAITO extra-chain airdrops; do not ship until a lockbox address appears in a weekly tree. 1% protocol fee on compounded RIVER. Tx 0x2143f4d9 is V1 unstake, not harvest. C1: sell PTSMAX. NFT lockbox required.
